scientific_integrity: General renewal and transform identities are credited to Bressloff and Linn (2026); no independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies to the one-dimensional no-thermal-diffusion telegraph particle with identical iid wall holding times and identical fixed splitting probability under both desorption protocols. Laplace order is not time-domain stochastic order. Means require finite wall waiting-time mean. The full underlying renewal transforms are previously known; new analytic crossing classification has substantive implicit-coverage risk.
title: A unique Laplace-order reversal between sticky-wall desorption protocols
